hoggish.oewn-00011346-s.tone: Compares the person to a pig outright, with none of the softening *piggy* has.

bawl.oewn-00066633-v.tone: Loud and undignified, but not unkind - it names the volume of the crying, not its cause.

choleric.oewn-00115732-s.tone: Anger as a defining quality, whether of the person or of the outburst itself.

dodgy.oewn-00149346-s.tone: The deception is skilled enough that nothing can be pinned down, which is what makes it suspect.

wily.oewn-00149346-s.tone: Skill in deception admired more than condemned - the disapproval is faint.

dishy.oewn-00220265-s.tone: British slang - casual and light, praise with no weight behind it.

spunky.oewn-00264860-s.tone: Affectionate praise for spirit - the courage is admired rather than feared.

reckless.oewn-00313654-s.tone: The gravest here - the unconcern is careless enough to imply danger.

gay.oewn-00365018-s.tone: Brightness offered as cheer - the pleasure is in the surface, and is meant kindly.

smutty.oewn-00422521-s.tone: Soot rather than filth - the dirt is superficial and comes off.

rude.oewn-00645747-a.tone: The blunt word - it names the failure of manners without softening it.

criminate.oewn-00825330-v.tone: Legalistic - it frames the fault as very nearly a crime.

pillory.oewn-00825488-v.tone: Public humiliation, deliberately staged - the criticism is meant to be watched.

tout.oewn-00884747-v.tone: The boasting is done on something's behalf rather than one's own.

blow.oewn-00884747-v.tone: Self-praise treated as hot air - the claim is loud and thin.

bitch.oewn-00909610-v.tone: Coarse - the word dismisses the meanness even as it names it.

allegiant.oewn-00964856-s.tone: Formal - it names the duty rather than the feeling.

benevolent.oewn-01115023-s.tone: Praises the disposition rather than any particular gift.

freehearted.oewn-01115023-s.tone: Warm - the giving is presented as coming from feeling, not duty.

handsome.oewn-01115129-s.tone: Praises the scale of the giving, and implies it exceeded what was owed.

liberal.oewn-01115129-s.tone: Abundance framed as generosity - the giving is ample rather than measured.

ambidextrous.oewn-01225960-s.tone: The pun softens it - the double-dealing sounds almost like a skill.

fallacious.oewn-01226630-s.tone: Deception with a plausible surface - it is built to be believed.

cannibalic.oewn-01266942-s.tone: The furthest word in the family - savagery named at its most extreme.

disciplinary.oewn-01303596-s.tone: Names correction or punishment in the neutral, official register.

disciplinal.oewn-01303596-s.tone: The stiffer twin of *disciplinary*, with the same official flatness.

longanimous.oewn-01740820-s.tone: Patience under provocation, named in its most formal register.

noisy.oewn-01926330-a.tone: The plain complaint - it names the sound as unwelcome, without heat.

couth.oewn-01954649-s.tone: The joke is in the word itself - refinement praised with one eyebrow raised.

mincing.oewn-01954782-s.tone: Mocks refinement as performance - the daintiness is put on.

loutish.oewn-01956681-s.tone: The lout takes up space and does not apologise - coarseness with no shame in it.

look_backward.oewn-02136564-v.tone: The literal direction, with none of the wistfulness *look back* can carry.

plagiarize.oewn-02282906-v.tone: Theft of words and ideas - it names the taking as dishonest, not merely careless.

bullet-headed.oewn-02335420-s.tone: The same accusation with a harder image, and unkind about the head as well.

plunder.oewn-02350284-v.tone: Taking wholesale rather than piecemeal - the scale is the accusation.

misanthropical.oewn-02472810-s.tone: The longer form of the same judgement, with the same reach.

questioning.oewn-02473075-s.tone: Nearly neutral - it names the doubt without treating it as a fault.

doubting.oewn-02473075-s.tone: Names the state of mind, with no verdict attached to it.

omniscient.oewn-02580010-s.tone: Wisdom claimed without limit, stated in its most formal form.

eared.oewn-02592267-s.tone: Shabby from use, and slightly fond about it.
